title: compliance/intel.json
description: Compliance candidate list: rule and vulnerability findings that are worth turning into a check. Candidates are proposals, not tests — author-check.yml turns an accepted candidate into a real check.

status.description: SOURCES_DEGRADED when a source could not be reached. Do not report OK with an unreachable source.

oscal_release.description: Pinned usnistgov/oscal-content release used for 800-53 titles (e.g. v1.5.0).

sources.description: Every source actually consulted, with the URL. A candidate without a source is an invention.

delta.description: This visit: catalog already testing a relevant control vs relevant missing vs judged not applicable to this estate.

catalog_covered.description: Relevant controls already mapped on a catalog check (nist:).

relevant_missing.description: Applies to this estate and is not covered. Should match candidates length this run (capped at 10).

not_applicable.description: Published titles judged not applicable here. Should match skipped_non_network length.

candidates.description: Persistent ranked backlog capped at 10. Empty is valid and means status NO_CANDIDATES.

keys.description: Every source-supported canonical relationship key for this candidate. Include control and existing test ids; do not invent devices. The candidate id remains in id, not in keys.

why_network.description: Why this is a network or routing concern. Endpoint and SaaS findings belong in skipped_non_network.

kind.description: vulnerability candidates carry cve and affected_versions.

affected_devices.description: Devices in this network matching the advisory, from the inventory diff — not every device the vendor lists.

source_control.description: Canonical 800-53 id as framework:id, e.g. nist-800-53:AC-17.

resolved_from.description: Inbound id when the user started from 800-171 or a STIG Viewer URL, e.g. nist-800-171:3.1.7.

suggested_assert.description: Concretely what a check would assert. Must be expressible with an assert type in tests/CAPABILITIES.yml.

maps_to_existing.description: NET-COMP rule id this extends, or 'none'.

skipped_non_network.description: Shown so a reviewer can see what was filtered out and why the list is short.
